messages:
maria: quick idea: emit a tiny immutable billing envelope at ingest (tenant, req_id, model_hint, fp, schema) and push heavy attribution to async stitcher. aim: reduce p99 tail on generation calls. thoughts?
ajay: ingest helps latency but complicates rollbacks/backfills. if we commit to a fingerprint at ingest we must version the scheme.
sam: agree. also need replayable proofs for audits. store a short checksum in envelope.
priya: fingerprint proto: canonicalize input -> prefix_hash = sha256(canonical) -> fp = b64url(sha256(prefix_hash + tenant))[:22]. include schema_id. document canonicalization in SDKs.
ajay: compaction idea: write envelopes to a compacted topic keyed by fp for quick audits, keep raw events in cold store 14d for rehydrates. compaction window needs to be explicit.
maria: propose compaction window 72h, raw retention 14d, late arrivals -> backfill path that emits audit deltas. also add scheme_id & proof20 in envelope.
sam: rollout: canary 1% -> measure stitcher mismatch rate between ingest pre-annotations and stitcher outputs. require <0.05% mismatch over 24h.
priya: metrics: envelope_emit_rate, envelope_size_p95, stitch_mismatch_count, tenant_mismatch_rate. alerts on mismatch >0.1% for 1h.
maria: actions: Priya write fingerprint + canonicalization RFC. Ajay estimate storage/network delta for envelopes. Sam draft replay/diff tool and compaction playbook. I'll open prototype branch to start emitting envelopes into a test topic.
ajay: note cross-region: fingerprint must be bit-identical across languages. unknown schema -> route to slow path.
priya: +1 on RFC.
sam: +1 on diff tool.
